If already faithful and idiomatic, preserve the exact target bytes.", "context": {"book": "Adventures of Huckleberry Finn", "chapter": "CHAPTER XIII.", "unit": 16, "previous_english": ["“Why, there ain’t but one.”", "“What, you don’t mean the Walter Scott?”", "“Yes.”"], "previous_reviewed_russian": ["— Да он же один тут.", "— Что, неужто на «Уолтере Скотте»?", "— Да."]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "043-016-0040", "tag": "p", "text": "“Good land! what are they doin’ there, for gracious sakes?”", "sha256": "6dd3cda4a8741001acc1292713de739830526e35c3f294cf026473f71ef60fa5", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[40]", "source_html": "“Good land! what are they doin’ there, for gracious sakes?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0041", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, they didn’t go there a-purpose.”", "sha256": "5791b3e05b75b86ebf1dfdf91f1c6a76aaf727cf4ca816a99798c322bb85ef8e", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[41]", "source_html": "“Well, they didn’t go there a-purpose.”"}, {"id": "043-016-0042", "tag": "p", "text": "“I bet they didn’t! Miss Hooker was a-visiting up there to the town—”"}, {"id": "043-016-0044", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes, Booth’s Landing—go on.”", "sha256": "ae8a13ee4c6edfb7bd9793461fb6d81b43c61bd436584d6d75f7eb0666f5c19c", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[44]", "source_html": "“Yes, Booth’s Landing—go on.”"}, {"id": "043-016-0045", "tag": "p", "text": "“She was a-visiting there at Booth’s Landing, and just in the edge of the evening she started over with her nigger woman in the horse-ferry to stay all night at her friend’s house, Miss What-you-may-call-her I disremember her name—and they lost their steering-oar, and swung around and went a-floating down, stern first, about two mile, and saddle-baggsed on the wreck, and the ferryman and the nigger woman and the horses was all lost, but Miss Hooker she made a grab and got aboard the wreck. Well, about an hour after dark we come along down in our trading-scow, and it was so dark we didn’t notice the wreck till we was right on it; and so we saddle-baggsed; but all of us was saved but Bill Whipple—and oh, he was the best cretur!—I most wish’t it had been me, I do.”", "sha256": "f3118b559baee0853fddfa576215f887def4361848cd53d5621f79e9901dd3a2", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[45]", "source_html": "“She was a-visiting there at Booth’s Landing, and just in the edge of the evening she started over with her nigger woman in the horse-ferry to stay all night at her friend’s house, Miss What-you-may-call-her I disremember her name—and they lost their steering-oar, and swung around and went a-floating down, stern first, about two mile, and saddle-baggsed on the wreck, and the ferryman and the nigger woman and the horses was all lost, but Miss Hooker she made a grab and got aboard the wreck. Well, about an hour after dark we come along down in our trading-scow, and it was so dark we didn’t notice the wreck till we was right on it; and so we saddle-baggsed; but all of us was saved but Bill Whipple—and oh, he was the best cretur!—I most wish’t it had been me, I do.”"}, {"id": "043-016-0046", "tag": "p", "text": "“My George! It’s the beatenest thing I ever struck. And then what did you all do?”", "sha256": "339325296e8fdc6d3b5356b9734d3bc9a5a3171bb7821773798f4a035d861d00", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[46]", "source_html": "“My George! It’s the beatenest thing I ever struck. And then what did you all do?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0047", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, we hollered and took on, but it’s so wide there we couldn’t make nobody hear. So pap said somebody got to get ashore and get help somehow. I was the only one that could swim, so I made a dash for it, and Miss Hooker she said if I didn’t strike help sooner, come here and hunt up her uncle, and he’d fix the thing. I made the land about a mile below, and been fooling along ever since, trying to get people to do something, but they said, ‘What, in such a night and such a current? There ain’t no sense in it; go for the steam ferry.’ Now if you’ll go and—”", "sha256": "62adc887c7b40bfc466cfcf9e84e2d04f2cb0242f61447e5f0cffb37fb9006e9", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[47]", "source_html": "“Well, we hollered and took on, but it’s so wide there we couldn’t make nobody hear. Do you reckon your pap—”"}, {"id": "043-016-0049", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why that’s all right. Miss Hooker she tole me, particular, that her uncle Hornback—”", "sha256": "5f082f7e2a815ecb695d78eaf2ee4650bcd5f4d8e458e88ec858afdc6830168f", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[49]", "source_html": "“Why that’s all right. Miss Hooker she tole me, particular, that her uncle Hornback—”"}, {"id": "043-016-0050", "tag": "p", "text": "“Great guns! is he her uncle? Looky here, you break for that light over yonder-way, and turn out west when you git there, and about a quarter of a mile out you’ll come to the tavern; tell ’em to dart you out to Jim Hornback’s, and he’ll foot the bill. And don’t you fool around any, because he’ll want to know the news. Tell him I’ll have his niece all safe before he can get to town. Hump yourself, now; I’m a-going up around the corner here to roust out my engineer.”", "sha256": "c6648c38e2d989022faf0717270d4aaaf341f66e5afaf09e94e7e29b2183cc8e", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[50]", "source_html": "“Great guns! is he her uncle? Looky here, you break for that light over yonder-way, and turn out west when you git there, and about a quarter of a mile out you’ll come to the tavern; tell ’em to dart you out to Jim Hornback’s, and he’ll foot the bill. And don’t you fool around any, because he’ll want to know the news. Tell him I’ll have his niece all safe before he can get to town. Hump yourself, now; I’m a-going up around the corner here to roust out my engineer.”"}, {"id": "043-016-0051", "tag": "p", "text": "I struck for the light, but as soon as he turned the corner I went back and got into my skiff and bailed her out, and then pulled up shore in the easy water about six hundred yards, and tucked myself in among some woodboats; for I couldn’t rest easy till I could see the ferry-boat start. But take it all around, I was feeling ruther comfortable on accounts of taking all this trouble for that gang, for not many would a done it. I wished the widow knowed about it. I judged she would be proud of me for helping these rapscallions, because rapscallions and dead beats is the kind the widow and good people takes the most interest in.", "sha256": "e01d0d011cb2b17bbdd32fb553a30c6762f939621abdfbb75d6f21e6bbc40abd", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[51]", "source_html": "I struck for the light, but as soon as he turned the corner I went back and got into my skiff and bailed her out, and then pulled up shore in the easy water about six hundred yards, and tucked myself in among some woodboats; for I couldn’t rest easy till I could see the ferry-boat start. But take it all around, I was feeling ruther comfortable on accounts of taking all this trouble for that gang, for not many would a done it. I wished the widow knowed about it. I judged she would be proud of me for helping these rapscallions, because rapscallions and dead beats is the kind the widow and good people takes the most interest in."}, {"id": "043-016-0052", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "The Wreck", "sha256": "1280cb96d4ee7e173cb611bf3faa45a780abc01417703046b31856d6acf332d2", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c13-107", "image_id": "c13-107"}, {"id": "043-016-0053", "tag": "p", "text": "Well, before long, here comes the wreck, dim and dusky, sliding along down! I pulled all around her and hollered a little, but there wasn’t any answer; all dead still. I felt a little bit heavy-hearted about the gang, but not much, for I reckoned if they could stand it, I could.", "sha256": "8f20c373e9803280693403fdf4993d1a53876ae47a09fe4566d20c4554ff742e", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[53]", "source_html": "Well, before long, here comes the wreck, dim and dusky, sliding along down! I pulled all around her and hollered a little, but there wasn’t any answer; all dead still. I felt a little bit heavy-hearted about the gang, but not much, for I reckoned if they could stand it, I could."}, {"id": "043-016-0054", "tag": "p", "text": "Then here comes the ferry-boat; so I shoved for the middle of the river on a long down-stream slant; and when I judged I was out of eye-reach, I laid on my oars, and looked back and see her go and smell around the wreck for Miss Hooker’s remainders, because the captain would know her uncle Hornback would want them; and then pretty soon the ferry-boat give it up and went for the shore, and I laid into my work and went a-booming down the river.", "sha256": "c7ca0996d2b0dd02bbe59ea0ed1b60189097454e7156605aadfdc444084b9d40", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[54]", "source_html": "Then here comes the ferry-boat; so I shoved for the middle of the river on a long down-stream slant; and when I judged I was out of eye-reach, I laid on my oars, and looked back and see her go and smell around the wreck for Miss Hooker’s remainders, because the captain would know her uncle Hornback would want them; and then pretty soon the ferry-boat give it up and went for the shore, and I laid into my work and went a-booming down the river."}, {"id": "043-016-0055", "tag": "p", "text": "It did seem a powerful long time before Jim’s light showed up; and when it did show, it looked like it was a thousand mile off. By the time I got there the sky was beginning to get a little gray in the east; so we struck for an island, and hid the raft, and sunk the skiff, and turned in and slept like dead people.", "sha256": "1a962eb92eeeb2749d36828279b377d8eb67f5d7d0850469239efebcea3c481c", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[55]", "source_html": "It did seem a powerful long time before Jim’s light showed up; and when it did show, it looked like it was a thousand mile off. By the time I got there the sky was beginning to get a little gray in the east; so we struck for an island, and hid the raft, and sunk the skiff, and turned in and slept like dead people."}, {"id": "043-016-0056", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "We turned in and Slept", "sha256": "1c46eb59d34763e3629ef5ee7c060b7e4a491aa8179256c503b43e66be09a88e", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c13-108", "image_id": "c13-108"}, {"id": "043-016-0057", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "Turning over the Truck", "sha256": "22670e12da7496394cd5b2a18ce1da57fd07c8fc8d3d3e116bd39e3d4f7f4cbd", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c14-109", "image_id": "c14-109"}], "final_rows": [{"source_id": "043-016-0040", "target": "— Господи помилуй! Да что они там делают, ради всего святого?", "source_sha256": "6dd3cda4a8741001acc1292713de739830526e35c3f294cf026473f71ef60fa5", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0040", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d02a574bd62260ba525941c8c7edef73ced01e349331dcd46c183c171adc511d"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0041", "target": "— Ну, они же туда не нарочно попали.", "source_sha256": "5791b3e05b75b86ebf1dfdf91f1c6a76aaf727cf4ca816a99798c322bb85ef8e", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0041", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "bbcfda4e1f0467398b25132a7190762d279699bd7107fd7116b543d068138469"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0042", "target": "— Ещё бы, что нарочно! Боже ты мой, у них никаких шансов, если они не слезут оттуда поскорее! Да как же, чёрт возьми, они вообще в такую беду угодили?", "source_sha256": "c55edbda0b6d7d308eb5df9b4e17d79db5fc3f7c3682acd034b9886183a26d95", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0042", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f81970bdf20642af825a45dd99b201d4072cd1d05f3c4e7a27f64327f8a45cd8"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0043", "target": "— Проще простого. Мисс Хукер гостила там, в городе…", "source_sha256": "3d96e596ed821ffd28ed7ef72a4d9133e654fec2222d2b26ef95e069b34a8e42", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0043", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b13d28fc19658834f209c2b35750873fffda99259d98dec65c0ca3ac5f953a7a"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0044", "target": "— Да, в Бутс-Лэндинге. Дальше.", "source_sha256": "ae8a13ee4c6edfb7bd9793461fb6d81b43c61bd436584d6d75f7eb0666f5c19c", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0044", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e7832c83604274b87bdb48268520ebd999151621bf87f72e85b3bd920a053638"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0045", "target": "— Она гостила там, в Бутс-Лэндинге, и как раз под вечер отправилась со своей негритянкой на конном пароме, чтобы переночевать у подруги, у мисс как-бишь-её, не помню фамилии, — и они потеряли рулевое весло, их развернуло, и понесло вниз по течению кормой вперёд миль на две, и они налетели на обломки, и паромщик, и негритянка, и лошади — все погибли, но мисс Хукер успела ухватиться и забралась на обломки. Ну вот, часа через час после темноты мы плыли вниз на нашей торговой барже, и было так темно, что мы не заметили обломков, пока не оказались прямо на них; и тут мы тоже налетели; но спаслись все, кроме Билла Уиппла — а он, ох, был такой славный малый! — я, право, чуть не желаю, чтобы это был я.", "note": "", "source_sha256": "f3118b559baee0853fddfa576215f887def4361848cd53d5621f79e9901dd3a2", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0045", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "63cca5d39897fd44571629c83d84c3619729455276578ff1344441184cdb8d6d"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0046", "target": "— Боже правый! Ничего подобного в жизни не слыхал. А что вы потом все сделали?", "source_sha256": "339325296e8fdc6d3b5356b9734d3bc9a5a3171bb7821773798f4a035d861d00", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0046", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "648982acca5872b1e676ffa7b0772a4b2d7ef90675dbbdd6b4ec213f11c97bcd"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0047", "target": "— Ну, мы кричали и надрывались, но там такая ширь, что нас никто не мог услышать. Тогда папа сказал, что кому-то надо добраться до берега и как-нибудь позвать на помощь. Плавать умел только я, так что я бросился вплавь, а мисс Хукер сказала: если я раньше не найду помощь, то пусть иду сюда и разыщу её дядю, он всё устроит. Я выбрался на берег милей ниже и с тех пор всё хожу, пытаюсь уговорить людей что-нибудь сделать, а они мне: «Что, в такую ночь да при таком течении? Никакого смысла; ступай к паровому парому». Так вот, если вы пойдёте и…", "source_sha256": "62adc887c7b40bfc466cfcf9e84e2d04f2cb0242f61447e5f0cffb37fb9006e9", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0047", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e2b8dcfbe089ed3c3824238a5932665bd80499f03277426077ffb5f4b4e55556"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0048", "target": "— Ей-богу, я бы рад, и, будь оно неладно, не знаю, может, и пойду; но кто, чёрт возьми, будет за это платить? Ты думаешь, твой папа…", "source_sha256": "05e5c5d74a46b82df144ee87fce070dc1c74fb2e0fef51266d3ccc8849218699", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0048", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fc5b548db12505d922ed527fc66eae773b05ccb092808cebdf6aedaf009bca97"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0049", "target": "— Да это всё в порядке. Мисс Хукер мне особо сказала, что её дядя Хорнбэк…", "source_sha256": "5f082f7e2a815ecb695d78eaf2ee4650bcd5f4d8e458e88ec858afdc6830168f", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0049", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "2736e746256b3a5c4a0af7789733a116dee5804a9835f899203ef85f91774314"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0050", "target": "— Вот это да! Так он ей дядя? Слушай-ка, дуй вон к тому огню, а как доберёшься, сверни на запад, и примерно через четверть мили выйдешь к трактиру; скажи там, чтоб тебя живо доставили к Джиму Хорнбэку, он за всё заплатит. И не мешкай, потому что ему захочется узнать новости. Скажи, что я доставлю его племянницу целёхонькой раньше, чем он доберётся до города. А в общем и целом мне было довольно приятно, что я столько хлопотал ради этой шайки, потому что не многие бы на это пошли. Мне хотелось, чтобы вдова об этом узнала.
